name: adult white dragon
desc: Adult White Dragon is a CR 13 dragon.

actions.name: ice walk
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, &Reference[Difficult Terrain] composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

actions.name: legendary resistance
actions.desc: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes three [[/item Rend]] attacks.

actions.name: cold breath
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=8P7hmd3Nron4RAIv]], each [[lookup @target.affects.type activity=8P7hmd3Nron4RAIv]] in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=8P7hmd3Nron4RAIv]]-foot Cone. Failure: [[/damage average]] damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: freezing burst
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=U2i9u4ELjeLQfePP]], each [[lookup @target.affects.type activity=U2i9u4ELjeLQfePP]] in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=U2i9u4ELjeLQfePP]]-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=U2i9u4ELjeLQfePP]] feet. Failure: [[/damage average]] damage, and the target's Speed is 0 until the end of the target's next turn. Failure or Success: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: frightful presence
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplFear000000]{Fear}, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC [[lookup @attributes.spell.dc]]). The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: pounce
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one [[/item Rend]] attack.
